(async()=>{ const P=__app.player, V=__app.view; P.video.pause(); P.seekTo(3); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); V.showEye(1); const a=await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(),'eyeL_before'); V.showEye(2); const b=await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(),'eyeR_before'); V.showEye(1); return a+' || '+b; })()

(async()=>{ const P=__app.player, V=__app.view; __app.showTab('player'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); V.showEye(1); const a=await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(),'eyeL_after'); V.showEye(2); const b=await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(),'eyeR_after'); V.showEye(1); return a+' || '+b; })()
